title: Graham, and Trump, Triumph: Six Takeaways From South Carolina’s Senate Runoff
summary: President Trump went all in for Senator Darline Graham in a primary runoff on Tuesday. It worked, preserving his undefeated streak in Republican Senate primaries this year.
